Running.note: Whole detail page inside a bounded frame: four status cards (delivery/desired/execution/freshness with their tones), run details grid, collapsed replay-masked Inputs, and the Steps list; the actions row shows Cancel run + Open session as the presentation allows.

PreparedForDelivery.note: Prepared branch — Start delivery enabled, 'Waiting for runtime acceptance.' in Steps. The `notice` prop is intentionally null: it renders as text-warning, which is unreadable on this theme's alpha warning token (see learnings/I.md).

FailedRun.note: Danger tone on the execution card plus the destructive failure band; the action row correctly collapses to Back + Refresh.

DeliveryUnavailable.note: deliveryCapabilityEnabled={false} disables Start delivery and shows the capability band, with actionError beneath it in text-destructive.
